description: Seeded, non-exhaustive capability inventory. Statuses describe the documented Ferrule subset, not measured product parity. Vendor acceptance, Ferrule self-roundtrip, interpreter execution, authoring, debugging and generated backends are independent. Corpus totals are historical repository evidence, not fresh measurements.

profiles.description: Native MapForce Enterprise 2026r2 components and workflows; no Ferrule-only semantic dependencies.
Explicit Ferrule-only components and retained metadata; successful Ferrule re-import is not vendor compatibility.

evidence.description: Official edition capability baseline; the inventory is not yet exhaustive.
Official release history; target release is pinned independently of the latest release.
Official source and target support notes.
Official generated-code feature support; capability availability differs by backend.
Official Enterprise manual used to expand the seeded inventory.
Recorded baseline and explicitly remaining workflow gaps; not a fresh vendor run.
Supported import/export subset and resource boundaries.
Generated Rust and C# library support and host contracts.
Informational import/validation/export/Ferrule re-import survey; no vendor execution proof.
Safe execution survey distinguishes execution, output publication, expected failures and reference matches.
Corpus lowering/emission survey; does not compile and execute the whole corpus.
Isolated local vendor oracle harness; code presence is not a vendor-execution result.
Resilient semantic importer and project conversion.
Canonical mapping export, including Ferrule-specific metadata.
Bounded sequence/control and structured-variable lowering.
Typed join import and explicit unsupported combinations.
Recognized scalar and structured user-defined mapping functions.
Recognized external code wrappers; no general arbitrary-code runtime.
Typed graph node model.
Typed scope, sequence and construction model.
Primary and named source/target project model.
Native scope authoring controls.
Bounded searchable run reports.
Ferrule library components for recursive and hierarchy constructions.
Retained Ferrule EDI layout and lexical metadata.
Captured-response boundaries and Ferrule provenance.
